description.content: Calculates totals for a previously-executed query, referenced by its queryUuid. Re-runs the source query's MetricQuery against the warehouse so totals are correct for every metric type (count distinct, average, ratio, etc.) — unlike client-side cell summation, which only works for sum/count. The requested `kind` selects which totals to compute.

variable.description: (Required) The UUID of the previously-executed query to compute totals from

response.name: Success
